title: Close-up Portrait with Parental Advisory Label
coreRelationships: The subject's face fills the majority of the frame, creating an intimate and direct gaze.
The vibrant false eyelashes and gold grill stand out as focal points against the natural skin tones.
The styled baby hairs and braided hair frame the face, adding texture and detail.
The 'Parental Advisory' label acts as a small, contrasting graphic element in the corner, providing context.
